news.title: ‘Be less sh*t’ - Jurgen Klopp set simple challenge as Germany boss as ex-Liverpool manager is backed to bring ‘heavy metal football’ to the Euros & World Cup
news.lede: Klopp stepped down as Liverpool boss in 2024Klopp stepped away from the stresses of coaching during the summer of 2024 when bringing an iconic nine-year stint at Anfield to a close . He had delivered Premier League and Champions League titles to Merseyside.Having opted to cut his contract short, the enigmatic tactician linked up with Red Bull as their Head of Global Football. He was linked with several prominent posts across Europe - including the one at Real Madrid . Eventually, after watching Julian Nagelsmann oversee a disappointing last-32 exit at the 2026 World Cup , Klopp was lured back into the dugout by Die Mannschaft.

news.title: Inside the rise of Konsa and why World Cup star can inspire England's next gen
news.lede: Ezri Konsa took a long and winding road to a World Cup with England. The Arsenal defender reached the very top in his own time and on a well trodden path. Konsa, 28, is one of England’s most reliable defenders, is one of the first names on the team sheet under Thomas Tuchel and has been outstanding for Arsenal since his £55m summer move to the Emirates. His former Charlton academy director Steve Avory saw the competitive edge, “big personality” and quality in Konsa when he was a teenager.

news.title: What Jude Bellingham said to Cristian Romero as World Cup row erupts during Madrid derby
news.lede: Bellingham and Romero clashed during Sunday’s derby (Picture: Getty Images) Jude Bellingham and Cristian Romero renewed England vs Argentina hostilities in a bad-tempered Madrid derby with the brutal digs shared between the two now revealed.Atletico Madrid beat neighbours Real in a lively showdown on Sunday where Jose Mourinho accused officials of making huge errors in the 2-1 defeat.There were battles across the pitch with Bellingham and Romero clashing in their first meeting since Argentina beat England in a wild World Cup semi-final in the summer.The two were seen exchanging words at various stages of the match with Movistar’s El Día Después picking up exactly what was said. ‘When you’re with [Lionel] Messi, you talk a lot. But here, nothing,’ Bellingham said to Romero, who left Tottenham to join Atletico in the summer transfer window.Bellingham also called the Argentine a ‘coward.’

news.title: Coca-Cola and Zepto Turn Spains FIFA World Cup Victory Into a collectible Piece of History
news.lede: New Delhi [India], September 22: Coca-Cola India is turning a defining FIFA World Cup moment into a keepsake for football fans, with limited-edition golden cans available across Delhi/NCR. Introduced through the Own a Piece of History campaign, the collectible cans are being brought to consumers through Coca-Colas partnership with leading quick-commerce platform Zepto, where consumer response has been overwhelming, with pre-orders pouring in since the launch week. news.title: Ghana names squad for 2026 Amputee Football World Cup
news.lede: A provisional 20-player squad has been named by Ghana's amputee national team the Black Challenge for the 2026 Amputee Football World Cup. The Ghana Paralympic Committee has announced a 20-player provisional squad for the Black Challenge ahead of the 2026 Amputee Football World Cup in Mexico. The tournament is scheduled to take place from November 13 to 22 in San Juan de los Lagos, with Ghana preparing for another appearance on the global stage. The provisional squad consists of three goalkeepers and 17 outfield players drawn from clubs and programmes in Ghana and Türkiye.

news.title: Sheffield FC: BBC podcast goes behind the scenes at 'world's oldest football club'
news.lede: Sheffield FC's 2025-26 campaign is the subject of a new BBC podcast Mud, Sweat and Cheers: Trouble at the Bottom. A football club at the heart of a tug-of-war between a Qatari-backed venture capital firm and a rock star probably isn't that unusual nowadays. This is the position that Sheffield FC, founded in 1857 and widely considered the world's oldest football club, were in earlier this year. Mud, Sweat and Cheers: Trouble at the Bottom – Sheffield FC, a six-part podcast series from BBC Local and BBC Radio Sheffield and hosted by Sheffield singer-songwriter Self Esteem, goes behind the scenes during an extraordinary season for an extraordinary club.

news.title: Star coaches make their bows as Nations League returns
news.lede: Jurgen Klopp and Zinedine Zidane headline the coaching changes, with the former Liverpool boss returning to his native Germany and the France legend taking over Les Bleus. (EPA Images pic) PARIS: The 2026/27 Nations League kicks off on Thursday, but all eyes will be on the touchlines as a starry cast of new coaches, including Zinedine Zidane and Jurgen Klopp, prepare to make their debuts in international football. The end of World Cup cycles usually herald in a host of new faces, however, the 2026 vintage is particularly bountiful, with no fewer than 10 European nations having appointed a new coach since this summer's tournament in North America. Most notable are 1998 World Cup winner and France legend Zidane, who succeeds Didier Deschamps as Les Bleus boss, and former Liverpool manager Klopp, who takes over his native Germany.

news.title: Copper Princesses to face China in World Cup warm-up
news.lede: Zambia’s Copper Princesses will face China in an international friendly as part of their final preparations for the 2026 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup in Morocco. The match will be played in Rabat on 9 October, eight days before the tournament gets underway. Football Association of Zambia (FAZ) General Secretary Charles Chakatazya said the fixture would give Zambia valuable preparation against Asian opposition ahead of their Group D meeting with Japan. “As part of the Copper Princesses’ preparations for the World Cup, we have secured a high-profile friendly against China to give the girls a taste of Asian football,” Chakatazya said.
